name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2018 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques that the verified 2018 record supports: VPNFilter's Modbus-monitoring plugin as ATT&CK lists it on S1010 (Talos, 23 May 2018), the watering holes on ICS-related sites in TA18-074A, and Dragos's reporting of ICS vendor compromises linked to XENOTIME. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2018.md. Scores: 100 the source or the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.

Dragos reports compromises of ICS vendors and manufacturers in 2018 linked to XENOTIME; the library maps T0862 to G0088 at group level (basis: Reported). Sources [72][119] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2018.md.
